name: Visual Foundations
description: Three optional, accessible SVG diagrams for digital information, file storage, and semantic Web structure.

assets.alt_text: Eight binary bits grouped together make one byte; the example shows eight positions and a bracket labelled one byte.
assets.caption: Eight bits make one byte.
assets.text_equivalent: A byte is a group of eight bits. Each bit has one of two distinguishable states, and the group can represent a larger set of values.
assets.author: AetherLearn contributors
assets.reduced_motion_alternative: Use the nearby text equivalent; the diagram has no animation.

assets.alt_text: A file sits inside a folder, the folder is kept on storage, and a separate copy is labelled backup.
assets.caption: Organize, store, and copy.
assets.text_equivalent: A file can be organized in a folder, stored on a device or service, and copied separately as a backup for recovery.
assets.author: AetherLearn contributors
assets.reduced_motion_alternative: Use the nearby text equivalent; the diagram has no animation.

assets.alt_text: A page outline contains a header, navigation, main content, and footer; meaningful landmarks help people and assistive technology move around the page.
assets.caption: Meaningful page landmarks.
assets.text_equivalent: A semantic page can expose header, navigation, main, and footer landmarks so people and assistive technology can understand and move through its structure.
assets.author: AetherLearn contributors
assets.reduced_motion_alternative: Use the nearby text equivalent; the diagram has no animation.
